    // One apex per face; one quad per undirected edge.
    Join(self: PolygonMesh3D, height: Number): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMeshOfFaces(
            Concatenate(self.Positions, self.FaceApexPoints(height)),
            self.EdgeStitchFaces((m, c) => [m.JoinFaceOfEdge(c)]));
